description: Search Yandex Market products by keyword with sort, price, condition, payment, rating, brand and seller filters. 1 point per returned record.

condition.description: Condition. Options: new = New, resale = Resale / used

payment.description: Payment method. Options: online = Online, card_courier = Card to courier, cash_courier = Cash to courier, postpaid_pickup = Pay at pickup point

sort.description: Sort by. Options: dpop = Popularity, aprice = Price: low to high, dprice = Price: high to low, rating = Rating, date = Newest, discount_p = Biggest discount

name: run_yandexmarket_products_search
